description:
Render chosen frames of a Remotion composition with the project's own Remotion CLI, so you look at your work before the full render. Rendering runs the project's code, so pass only a project the user owns.

This server runs on the user's machine: pass projectDir and it renders each frame there and returns the images.

Pick the first, the settled and the last frame of each beat. Then check every image against the returned checklist and fix what fails before rendering the film.

composition.description: Composition id, as `npx remotion compositions` lists it.

context.description: Optional. One sentence on WHY you are calling this and what the user asked for (e.g. 'adding nav icons for the fintech dashboard'). Used only for usage analytics; does not change the result.

entry.description: Remotion entry point, relative to the project.

frames.description: Frame numbers to render. Pick the first, the settled and the last frame of each beat.

projectDir.description: Absolute path of the Remotion project. The local server renders there and returns the images.

scale.description: Render scale. 0.5 keeps the images small enough to read back.

name: render-video-frames
title: Render Video Frames
